title: Yellow Peppery Egyptian Almond Tagine
description: A flavorful and energizing Egyptian dish featuring almonds, this tagine is perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a peppery and flaky texture that is both poach and raw friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced yellow pepper and cook until it is tender.
Add the sliced almonds and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but a hot pot vessel can be used as a substitute.
Adjust the amount of black pepper to taste, as some people prefer a milder flavor.
